name: 径向频谱分析
description: 分析 the radially-averaged frequency 频谱 for characteristic 模式. AI生成的 images often show anomalous spectral profiles.
mechanism: Computes radially-averaged power 频谱 and 分析 spectral profile shape. Deviations from natural profiles indicate 篡改.
parameters: FFT: 自适应, Averaging: radial bins, Metric: profile deviation
useCase: Detecting spectral 异常 in AI生成的 images

references.title: Dzanic, T. et al. (2020). Fourier Spectrum Discrepancies in Deep Network Generated Images. NeurIPS.
Frank, J. et al. (2020). Leveraging Frequency Analysis for Deep Fake Image Recognition. ICML.
Durall, R. et al. (2020). Watch Your Up-Convolution: CNN Based Generative Networks. CVPR.

strengths:
• Captures radial frequency 分布 模式
• Effective for detecting GAN checkerboard 伪影
• Azimuthal averaging reduces noise
• Content-independent 频谱分析
• Fast computation using FFT
limitations:
• Less effective for diffusion model 伪影
• JPEG压缩 adds spectral noise
• Small images limit radial frequency 分辨率
• Isotropic assumption may miss directional 伪影
• Some generators produce clean radial spectra
